title: UnlimitedEnchantPlus
description: UnboundEnchants is a Paper 1.21.x plugin that removes vanilla enchantment limits, allowing players with permission to apply unsafe and overpowered enchantments like Sharpness 100 or Knockback 10 on any item. It includes a simple /unboundenchants:unenchant
body:
UnboundEnchants is a powerful and flexible Paper 1.21.x plugin that completely removes vanilla Minecraft enchantment restrictions, giving players and server owners the ability to create truly custom and overpowered gear. With this plugin, enchantments are no longer limited by normal game caps, allowing levels like Sharpness 100, Knockback 10, Efficiency 50, and beyond.

Players with permission can apply unsafe enchantments to any item, unlocking full creative control over how tools, weapons, and armor behave. You are no longer restricted to vanilla rules — any enchantment can be applied to any item, including unusual combinations that are normally impossible in standard Minecraft.

The plugin includes a simple and powerful command system using /unboundenchants:unenchant <enchant> <level> [player], allowing users to apply or modify enchantments quickly and safely. All commands are permission-based to ensure proper server control and prevent abuse.

UnboundEnchants also includes a fully configurable system, letting server owners enable or disable features such as unsafe enchantments, item restrictions, and maximum enchant levels. Custom messages are included for actions like success, errors, and no permission responses, making it easy to customize for any server style.

Built with stability in mind, the plugin includes safe error handling to prevent crashes from invalid enchantments or incorrect usage. It is optimized for modern Paper servers and designed to run smoothly without affecting performance.

Whether you're creating a chaotic SMP, a custom PvP server, or a fun experimental world, UnboundEnchants gives you full control over enchantments and item power, breaking the limits of vanilla Minecraft while staying stable and configurable.
